title: The Bastard of Istanbul
author: Elif Şafak
current_text: Turkish novelist Elif Shafak was prosecuted under Article 301 of Turkish law for “insulting Turkishness” over a fictional character’s remarks in The Bastard of Istanbul describing the massacre of Armenians as genocide; she was acquitted after the prosecutor requested that the charges be dropped.

sources.quote:
The bestselling Turkish novelist Elif Shafak was acquitted earlier today of the charges of "insulting Turkishness" brought against her under Article 301 of Turkish law. The charges were dropped at the prosecutor's request.
Shafak faced up to three years in jail over remarks made by a fictional character in her latest novel, The Bastard of Istanbul, which referred to the massacre of Armenians in the first world war as genocide.
